requirements.prompt: Some people think governments should spend more on public transport than on roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
requirements.position: Prioritize public transport while maintaining essential roads.
requirements.ideas: Affordability for commuters; access to jobs; lower congestion; protect rural connections.

outline.purpose: Introduce the question and state your position: Prioritize public transport while maintaining essential roads.
Develop your requested ideas with reasons and examples: Affordability for commuters; access to jobs; lower congestion; protect rural connections.
Summarize the argument and return to the question.

rubric.text:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 | Task Response | Band 7
The main parts of the prompt are appropriately addressed.
A clear and developed position is presented.
Main ideas are extended and supported but there may be a
tendency to over-generalise or there may be a lack of focus and
precision in supporting ideas/material.
